title: Loan Calculator: Monthly Payment, Total Interest & APR
description: Free loan payment calculator for auto, personal and student loans: enter amount, rate and term for the payment, total interest and extra-payment savings.
lead: How much will a loan really cost each month, and how much interest will you pay? Enter the amount, rate and term, then try an extra payment or an origination fee to see how the cost changes.
